name: Fortran
needs: a Fortran 2008 compiler such as gfortran or ifx and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: Declare the player as `type(peep_t), target :: pe` (it holds pointers into itself, so do not copy it).
`peep_read` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: demo: decodes the test files and prints checksums
